newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 60,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 60,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 60,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
Despite an advantageous currency situation, this week's authorised tonnage award was not likely to be too large due to only average demand for export licences, they said.
"I don't think the tonnage is going to be that high this week...I'm not sure there's a huge requirement for licences at the moment," said one.
This week's maximum restitution for export licences was forecast at 45.894 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kg of sugar, based on the Paris March white sugar contract.
In its last tender on December 18, the EU awarded 40,500 tonnes at a maximum rebate of 46.316 Ecus.
